name: Neomarkets
about: Neomarkets is a trusted and regulated financial instruments broker, committed to providing seamless trading experiences for individual and institutional clients worldwide. Licensed and regulated by the CMA – UAE (Neomarkets MENA), with Neomarkets Group LTD regulated by the FSC of Mauritius and a partner company regulated in Kazakhstan (AFSA). Services: Forex, commodities (gold, silver, oil, energy), global equities and indices, on MT5, WebTrader and mobile.
audience: Individual and institutional traders in the Middle East and worldwide, English and Arabic speaking, from beginners to scalpers and algorithmic traders.
voice: Trusted, secure and transparent. Confident and clear, data-led, never hype. Bilingual (English and Arabic).
